description: This file defines an abstract class 'JobBase' which serves as a base class for jobs in a scheduling or dependency management system within the GCE service. It includes methods for handling dependency failures, straggling dependencies, and execution logic.

classes.name: JobBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing a unit of work or job within the GCE service, providing hooks for dependency failure, straggling dependencies, and execution.

methods.name: onDependencyFailed
methods.description: Abstract method to handle failure of job dependencies, accepting an exception that describes the failure reason.

methods.name: onDependencyStraggling
methods.description: Method invoked when dependencies are taking longer than expected to complete; logs the current straggling dependencies.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method that executes the job; returns the number of seconds before re-execution or 0 if the job is complete.
